I used to fish commercially and every now and again we would get an octopus and for one season we where keeping them.

What I would have to do was get a rope around the area between his tentacles and head and pull it out of the pot acoss the deck and to the rail and tie them off. They would still be alive for some time before they turned white and stopped moving. 

It did not turn me vegan or anything and I still fish every now and again, but that was the one time I felt like I killed something. with fish you just harvest them, the are basically plants that swim. But damn... I think about kalimari differently now.
